info.name: CrosswordQuest API - Week 12 Accounts and Week 11
info.description: Run "Log in (run this folder first)" first to save bearer tokens, then run Accounts and the Week 11 folders. Each request includes assertions.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set("adminUserId", pm.response.json().user.user_id);

pm.test("duplicate school ID answers 409", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); }); pm.test("error has the standard shape", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("SCHOOL_ID_TAKEN"); });

pm.test("duplicate email answers 409", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); }); pm.test("error has the standard shape", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("EMAIL_TAKEN"); });
pm.test("weak password answers 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("VALIDATION_FAILED"); });

pm.test("wrong password answers 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("INVALID_CREDENTIALS"); });
pm.collectionVariables.set("wrongLoginError", JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().error));

item.name: Unknown school ID has the same 401

exec: pm.test("unknown school ID answers the same 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().error)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("wrongLoginError")); });

pm.test("me answers 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.school_id).to.eql("2099-0001"); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.match(/password_hash|\$2[aby]\$/i); });
pm.test("missing token answers 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("AUTH_REQUIRED"); });

item.name: Current account with changed token answers 401

exec: pm.test("changed token answers 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("INVALID_TOKEN"); });
pm.test("X-Demo-User alone answers 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test("player gets 403", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("FORBIDDEN"); });

pm.test("admin gets 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().users.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.match(/password_hash|\$2[aby]\$/i); });
pm.test("admin promotes a player", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql("HOST"); });

item.name: Admin cannot change their own role

exec: pm.test("admin cannot change own role", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE"); });
